rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Rate law: rate = k[A]ᵐ[B]ⁿ (order from experiment, not formula). Zero/first/second order have distinct integrated forms.  ·  First order: t = (2.303/k) log([A]₀/[A]); t_½ = 0.693/k (independent of concentration).

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Fact.** Rate law: rate = k[A]ᵐ[B]ⁿ (order from experiment, not formula). Zero/first/second order have distinct integrated forms.  ·  **Fact.** First order: t = (2.303/k) log([A]₀/[A]); t_½ = 0.693/k (independent of concentration).  ·  **Fact.** Arrhenius: k = Ae^(−Ea/RT); Ea = 2.303R (t₂/t₁)·ln(k₂/k₁)·(T₁T₂)/(T₂−T₁).
